notes.md: - **Taper tantrum (2013):** In **May 2013** the **US Fed** signalled it would **taper** its large-scale asset (bond) purchases; money flowed out of emerging markets and the **rupee fell about 17%** against the US dollar, with nearly **US$17 billion** of reserves used, by 3 September 2013 (RBI).
